# Proverbs 8 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 8:2 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | At-[the]-top-of [the]-heights beside [the]-way, at-[the]-house-of [the]-paths she-stands. |
| LOGOS | On the heights beside the way, at the crossroads she takes her stand; |
| PNEUMA | She stands at the highest point along the road, right where the paths cross. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Beside [the]-gates, at-[the]-mouth-of [the]-city, at-[the]-entrance-of [the]-openings she-cries-out: |
| LOGOS | Beside the gates in front of the town, at the entrance of the portals she cries aloud: |
| PNEUMA | She positions herself at the city gates, at every entrance, and shouts: |

| LOGOS | O simple ones, learn prudence; O fools, learn sense. |
| PNEUMA | You who are naive — learn to be sharp! You who are foolish — get some sense! |

| PNEUMA | Every word I speak is just and fair. There's nothing twisted or crooked in anything I say. |
